skills.delivery_notes: brand is applied as a mark on a nearby enemy; while attached it periodically drops a meteor (small-radius fire AoE) at the marked enemy's position while the player moves freely. Meteor = ground_targeted_circle at the mark's location. Shaper-of-Flames variant guarantees ignite -> burn
recalls all active brands to the player and immediately re-attaches them to nearby enemies — a mark-relocation utility, not an offensive geometry; blink used as the reposition-of-marks utility handle

mapping_json.motion_frame: full-move caster: attach brand, run freely while meteors auto-fall on the marked target, Brand Recall to re-seed — never rooted

trigger_grammar.mark_identity: Armageddon Brand attached to enemy — a persistent emitter-mark that periodically procs a meteor while attached

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: MARK-kit: the brand is a mark applied to an enemy that acts as a persistent emitter, periodically calling a meteor (ground_targeted_circle) on the marked target while the player is free to move. trigger_grammar carries mark_identity + burst-damage consequence. FRICTION: the meteor procs on a TIMER while the mark is attached; the proc_trigger_condition enum has no 'timed-while-marked' member — approximated to on-mark-apply (the meteor-stream flows from the mark's active state). trigger_chain_shape=apply-consume-pair reflects Brand-Recall's re-attach cycle (apply brand -> consume/relocate -> re-apply), respecting MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 (single mark, no nested chain). Brand Recall itself is a mark-relocation utility (blink handle). Burn from the guaranteed-ignite Elementalist variant.
